trailhead.label: The car parks by the Segrino lake, the published start

cautions: Tricky, steep passages on the descent from the viewpoint towards Canzo: avoid it after heavy rain, when it is slippery.
Village roads in Canzo and Proserpio and a crossing of the provincial road at the start.
The Segrino lake is a protected site: keep your dog on a lead and out of the reed beds.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
